justification: Solid incremental application of standard complex-network centrality to algorithm co-occurrence, well executed with model comparison and IRR checks, but builds directly on prior single-entity extraction art.

Elegant extension of integrable MFT to the multispecies SSEP via a manifestly symmetric redundant representation, though its impact is confined to a narrow integrable-probability community and it is a theory-only contribution.
A straightforward set-intersection POS-tagging heuristic over WordNet with internally inconsistent evaluation metrics and no released resources, offering little methodological advance.
A detailed, well-motivated FIR observatory concept reusing proven Herschel hardware and a strong science case, but presenting no new science method or demonstrated observational results.
A thorough dual-standard LMF/TEI Lex-0 encoding workflow for Al-Mawrid with honest limitation analysis, though novelty is modest and quantitative evaluation covers only a single letter.
